settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your profile, passkeys and server preferences.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language Flixer uses on this device.
language.label: Display language
language.help: Missing or wrong translations? Help improve them on Weblate.

avatar.invalidType: Please choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
avatar.tooLarge: That image is too large. Please choose one under 2 MB.
avatar.fileRequirements: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 2 MB.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Update how you appear in Flixer.
profile.pendingEmailHint: Confirmation pending for {email}. Check your inbox to verify it.
profile.emailVerificationSent: Check {email} for a verification link to confirm your new email address.
profile.deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone.
profile.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently deletes your account and all associated data. Enter your password to confirm.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Use a strong password that you don't use anywhere else.

passkeys.description: Passkeys let you sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password.
passkeys.addDescription: Enter your password to add a new passkey to your account.
passkeys.disableRequiredDescription: Enter your password to allow signing in without a passkey again.
passkeys.disableRequiredFailed: Could not turn off the passkey requirement.
passkeys.empty: You haven't added any passkeys yet.
passkeys.removeDescription: Enter your password to remove "{name}". You won't be able to sign in with it anymore.
passkeys.noLongerRequired: A passkey is no longer required to sign in.
passkeys.nowRequired: A passkey is now required to sign in.
passkeys.requiredTitle: Require a passkey to sign in
passkeys.requiredDescription: When on, you must use one of your passkeys to sign in. Password-only sign-in is disabled.
passkeys.addBeforeRequired: Add a passkey first to turn this on.

errors.requestCancelled: The request was cancelled or timed out. {message}
errors.alreadyRegistered: This device already has a passkey registered for your account.

server.title: Server
server.description: Configure how this Flixer server behaves.
server.registrationDescription: Let new users create accounts on this server.
server.serverNameDescription: The name shown to clients connecting to this server.
server.serverAddressDescription: The public URL clients use to reach this server.
server.cachePathDescription: Directory used for transcoding and image caches.
server.logsPathDescription: Directory where server logs are written.
server.metadataPathDescription: Directory where downloaded metadata is stored.

admin.title: Admin Dashboard
admin.subtitle: Monitor and manage this Flixer server.

overview.serverDescription: Current server status and version information.
overview.storageDescription: Disk usage across your media libraries.
overview.recentActivityDescription: The latest activity across your server.

streams.title: Live streams
streams.description: Monitor active playback and transcoding sessions.
streams.ffmpegUnavailable: FFmpeg is not available, so transcoding sessions cannot be shown.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.description: Organize media, manage folders and configure metadata.
libraries.realtimeDescription: Watch folders for changes and update the library automatically.
libraries.artworkDescription: Automatically download posters and other artwork.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage accounts, access and registration policies.
users.editDescription: Update this user's access and account restrictions.
users.fullDashboardAccess: Can access all server settings and administration tools.
users.signUpPolicyDescription: Choose how new users can register for this server.
users.publicRegistrationDescription: Let anyone create an account on this server.
users.adminApprovalDescription: New accounts must be approved before they can sign in.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: View devices that have connected to this server.
devices.apiKeysDescription: Manage keys used by apps and integrations to access this server.

transcoding.title: Transcoding
transcoding.description: Configure video and audio transcoding behavior.
transcoding.hdrToneMappingDescription: Convert HDR video to SDR for compatible playback.
transcoding.throttleDescription: Limit transcoding speed to reduce resource usage when possible.

tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
tasks.description: View and manage recurring maintenance and library tasks.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Review recent server and application events.
logs.empty: No log entries match this filter.

general.title: Server settings
general.loginBannerPlaceholder: Message shown on the sign-in page
general.networkingDescription: Configure how clients connect to your server.
general.emailDescription: Configure email settings for server notifications.
general.notificationsDescription: Choose which server events send email notifications.
general.quickConnectDescription: Let users sign in on a device using a short code.
general.dangerZoneDescription: These actions affect server data and cannot be undone.

auth.signInDescription: Sign in to continue your Flixer experience.
auth.sessionCheckUnavailable: We couldn’t verify your saved session. Sign in again when you’re ready.
auth.registrationDisabled: Registration is disabled by your administrator.
auth.passkeySecondFactorDescription: Your password was correct. Confirm it’s you with any passkey on your account, such as a security key, your phone, or this device.
auth.registrationDescription: One account is all that stands between you and your next favorite.
auth.passwordGuidance: Use 8+ characters and a mix of letters, numbers, or symbols.
auth.verificationEmailSent: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account, then sign in. The link expires in 24 hours.
auth.cantFindEmail: Can’t find it? Check your spam folder, or try signing in to get the option to send it again.
auth.registrationAvailabilityError: Registration availability couldn’t be checked. Refresh the page to try again.
auth.passkeySecondFactorExpired: Your sign-in expired or the passkey wasn’t accepted. Enter your password again.
auth.passkeyCheckCancelled: Passkey check was cancelled or timed out. Try again.
auth.verificationEmailSentToast: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
auth.passkeyLoginCancelled: Passkey sign-in was cancelled or blocked ({message}).
auth.networkError: Flixer couldn’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
auth.registrationError: We couldn’t create your account. Check your details and try again.
auth.signInError: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your details and try again.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.welcomeDescription: Pick up where you left off, or find something new to get lost in.

verify.missingToken: This verification link is missing its token.
verify.accountReady: Your account is ready. You can sign in now.
verify.requestAnotherEmail: Sign in to request a new verification email.
